title: One-step Diffusion with Distribution Matching Distillation
tldr_zh: 反向 KL 梯度 = 真/假 score 之差，加教师 ODE 噪声-图像对回归锚定，一步 ImageNet-64 FID 2.62、COCO-30k 11.49。
tldr_en: DMD trains a one-step generator with a reverse-KL gradient (real minus fake score) plus LPIPS regression on teacher ODE noise-image pairs: FID 2.62 on ImageNet-64, 11.49 zero-shot COCO.
key_numbers: ImageNet-64 FID 2.62 (1 NFE) vs teacher EDM 2.32 (512 NFE), CM 6.20 (Table 1)
Ablation CIFAR/ImageNet: w/o distribution matching 3.82/9.21, w/o regression 5.58/5.61 (Table 2)
COCO-30k zero-shot FID 11.49 @0.09s vs SD v1.5 8.78 @2.59s, CFG 3 (Table 3)
COCO-30k CFG 8: DMD 14.93 / CLIP 0.320 vs SD 13.45 / 0.322 (Table 4)
Paired set: 100k pairs CIFAR-10 cond, 25k ImageNet-64, 500k LAION-6.25+, 12M LAION-6+ (Appendix B)
lambda_reg = 0.25; L2 instead of LPIPS gives 2.78 vs 2.66 (Appendix I)
